title: Fogbell Ferry
status: core + cabinet + 9 iterations in PR; dossier is iteration 10
summary: A fog-bound tidal flat below the Prismheart quay. The ferry sets out from the north-west corner as the fog bell begins to toll; every third toll the tide rises and the lowest ground is lost for good. Lantern passengers wait on docks scattered over the flat; take them aboard and reach the harbour in the south-east before the water takes your cell. Deterministic per seed, bit-exact between the Python rules, the C++ core and the Unreal cabinet.

mechanics.name: Flat
mechanics.text: S x S cells (7 / 8 / 9 by difficulty) with integer heights 1..S, each the higher of two draws, so the flat is mostly firm with scattered low channels. The ferry's start (north-west) and the harbour (south-east) sit on height S. Docks are raised to at least 2.

mechanics.name: Turn
mechanics.text: Move n/e/s/w one cell or wait. Moving off the flat or into water is refused and costs nothing. Then the turn counter advances.

mechanics.name: Tide
mechanics.text: tide = turn // 3. A cell is flooded when height <= tide, permanently. The whole flat is under water by turn 3S, so every voyage ends.

mechanics.name: Lanterns
mechanics.text: Entering a dock takes its passenger aboard (3 / 4 / 5 waiting). Aboard + waiting is always the total: lanterns are never lost.

mechanics.name: Harbour
mechanics.text: Entering the harbour ends the voyage: won with at least need aboard (2 / 3 / 4), otherwise lost with too few lanterns. Score = 10 x aboard + 2 x tide steps still to come (3S - turn, floored at 0).

mechanics.name: Drowning
mechanics.text: If the ferry's own cell is flooded after a turn the voyage is lost and the score stays 0.

mechanics.name: Watcher (demo)
mechanics.text: Flood-aware breadth-first search in n/e/s/w order: a cell may be entered at step k only if it is still dry at turn + k. Nearest reachable lantern until enough are aboard, then the harbour, else wait. Greedy wins 82 / 50 / 35 percent over 14-20 turn voyages; a planning player can do better.

mechanics.name: Guide (option 1)
mechanics.text: Practice mode marks the watcher's cell in blue and the hint says what the move does; cells that flood at the next toll are edged in red on both the Python screen and the cabinet.

mechanics.name: Saves
mechanics.text: Text save (shared DaedalusDesktopSaveText shape): difficulty, seed, turn, aboard, score, over, won, ferry, heights, passengers. Restore regenerates the flat from the seed and refuses a reshaped flat, a dock that was never drawn, bad counts or a live ferry under water.

mechanics.name: Controls
mechanics.text: Arrows / d-pad / stick steer one cell per press (one turn each); A / J / Space wait; R or pad Start restart. Cabinet class DesktopGames/DaedalusDesktopFogbellCore.h, registry id fogbell, save slot fogbell.dgs.

items.text: A flat-bottomed punt with a brass fog lantern at the bow; gold disc on the board.
A hooded amber lantern on a dock post; a passenger stands beneath it until the ferry arrives.
A low green-stone quay wall with a bell gantry; the voyage ends when the ferry enters.
Mud and shingle shaded by height; darker as it nears the tide, red-edged the toll before it floods, blue once under water.
A great bell on the quay that tolls each turn; every third toll the tide gauge rises one step.
A vertical post of S marks beside the board filling from the bottom as the tide rises.

storyline.text: Fog has closed the Prismheart quay. The lantern-bearers who light the inner court are stranded on the docks of the tidal flat and the tide is coming in.
The harbourmaster hands you the ferry: arrows move one cell a turn, the bell tolls, and every third toll the lowest ground goes under for good. (The tutorial rows appear only on the first turn.)
Each difficulty is a wider flat with more bearers to collect and more required at the harbour: 2 of 3, 3 of 4, then 4 of 5 on a nine-wide flat.
Making harbour with enough lanterns rings the bell clear; the tide steps still to come are the harbourmaster's thanks (+2 each).
Too few lanterns, or the tide takes the ferry. Pad A or R sets out again on the same seed so the flat can be learned.
The fogbell quay sits at the end of the Prismheart arcade row beside the chime ring; it is a side voyage, not a campaign gate, and landed lanterns add to the arcade scoreboard.
